## claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 [Not affected]

Grepped the whole repo for "claude-sonnet-4-5" and "sonnet". There are no references to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. The models in use are claude-3-7-sonnet-latest and the claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 default. No files were changed.

The retiring model ID is not used in code, config, docs or tests, so the Nov 30, 2026 retirement does not affect this repo.

change.title: npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too

source.quote: * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

tasks.reasoning:
The repo pins @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.20.9, which falls in the affected range <1.0.0. Nothing breaks today, because the old SDK keeps sending 2023-06-01 and no retirement date for that version is given. Moving to 1.0.0 is a large jump from 0.20.9 that changes the default API version to 2026-10-21. It also makes MessageParam a union, which may break TS code that types messages, and removes the sampling params. Do it as one PR covering:
- bump the SDK and rebuild lib/
- fix MessageParam typings
- check that no temperature/top_p/top_k reaches messages.create
- decide on the OpenTelemetry opt-out
- check response handling, which was not read by the scan.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-api-version-2026-10-21 (api-version): New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01. The repo's SDK 0.20.9 keeps sending anthropic-version 2023-06-01. It moves to 2026-10-21 only when the SDK is bumped to 1.0.0, so this is the same move.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`."
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. This only bites under API version 2026-10-21, which arrives with the SDK 1.0.0 bump. The Anthropic call sites record no temperature/top_p/top_k. The agent should still confirm that no shared config (e.g. a temperature option also used by the OpenAI/local providers) is passed to messages.create.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."
- anthropic:2026-10-14-ts-sdk-otel-default (other): TypeScript SDK 0.134.0 auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if a global tracer provider exists (unsure if affects; opt out with openTelemetry:false). The automatic OpenTelemetry span creation starts at SDK 0.134.0. The repo is on 0.20.9, so it only matters when this upgrade crosses 0.134.0. If the app registers a global tracer provider, the agent should pass openTelemetry:false or accept the new spans.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces."
